entities.summary: Romolo Murri was an Italian politician and ecclesiastic. A Catholic priest, he was suspended and later excommunicated for having joined the Lega Democratica Nazionale. For his political activism, he is considered a precursor of Italian Christian democracy and by extension of the Democrazia Cristiana party.
